question: Can an uninvested and uninitiated person be eligible for the ancestral rite?
premises: Eligibility for the ancestral rite is under consideration
A person may lack sacred-thread investiture
A person may lack formal initiation
inference: Even an uninvested and uninitiated person is fit to perform the ancestral rite
plain_english: Indeed, even one who is uninvested with the sacred thread and uninitiated is fit to take part in the ancestral rite.
